title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Meal-Status Rate for Booked Days (2026-27 Schedule)
content:
**Clause.** Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program day fees are still not discounted by sibling position. They are not discounted by rate basis either, except on an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year, and only there: the rate-basis rule of the board-approved 2026-27 booked-day fee schedule sets the rate charged for the day. That rule follows the rate basis recorded on the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge:

| Rate basis on the most recently posted tuition charge | Rate charged for the day |
|---|---|
| free-meal rate | a flat 10.00 |
| reduced-meal rate | the larger of 10.00 and 75 percent of the day rate |
| any other rate basis (standard rate, employee rate) | the day rate |

The rate basis is read from the latest tuition charge on the enrollment's billing history, by posting date. It is not read from the meal account on the booking date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical day rates)

| Rate basis on latest tuition charge | Day rate | Rate charged |
|---|---|---|
| free-meal rate | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| reduced-meal rate | 30.00 | 22.50 (75 percent of 30.00, larger than 10.00) |
| reduced-meal rate | 12.00 | 10.00 (75 percent of 12.00 is 9.00, so 10.00 is the larger) |
| employee rate | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| standard rate | 30.00 | 30.00 |

**Basis Q&A.** *A student's meal status changed to Free Meal Status after the latest tuition charge posted. Which applies to a booking now?* The rate basis recorded on the most recently posted tuition charge applies until a later tuition charge records another one.
